title: Bound level of the pair at the next order in the regime R

key_results.statement: $\Theta=(-1)^{\hat r}\sigma^{(1)}_3\sigma^{(2)}_3$ commutes with $H(P)$ for every diagonal on-site binding and every $P$; in the class the level lies in $\Theta=+1$, so $w_{12},w_{21}$ enter $E_b$ at no order.

Effective contract on the coefficient of $\lvert11\rangle$ through order $\epsilon^4$, remainder $O(\epsilon^6)$ in norm uniformly in $P$: $E_0+\sum_i(T_i^2/2M_i-T_i^4/8M_i^3)+w\Pi_0-\frac w2\{K,\Pi_0\}+\frac{w_{21}}{4M_1^2}T_1\Pi_0T_1+\frac{w_{12}}{4M_2^2}T_2\Pi_0T_2$.

Position form of the effective contract for every $P$: couplings $r\to r,r\pm2,r\pm4$ with $J_2,J_4$; $w_{11}$ terms at $r=0$ and between $0$ and $\pm2$; $w_{12},w_{21}$ terms at order $\epsilon^4$ at $r=\pm1$ only; $w_{22}$ does not enter at this order.
$E_b(P)$ through order $\epsilon^4$ in closed form for every $P$ (even in $P$, independent of $\eta$), remainder $O(\epsilon^6)$ at fixed hatted data, both signs of $w_{11}$.
$E_b''(0)=-4\varsigma\nu a/\sqrt{1+u^2}+\nu\,\mathcal C(u)+O(\epsilon^6)$ with $\mathcal C$ explicit in $u$, $\gamma_s$, $\gamma_c$, $\gamma_m$.
$\mathfrak m_b=-\varsigma(\mathfrak m_1+\mathfrak m_2)\sqrt{1+u^2}\,[1+\varsigma\sqrt{1+u^2}\,\mathcal C/(4a)+O(\epsilon^4)]$, a relative correction of order $\epsilon^2$.

With the next-order binding cost, (11.16) holds at relative order $\epsilon^2$ only where $(1+u^2)\mathcal C=4\mathcal E_4$; otherwise the leading difference is $-[(1+u^2)\mathcal C-4\mathcal E_4]/(16a_1a_2)$, nonzero for $w_{11}<0$ at small enough $u$ unless $\gamma_c=2\gamma_m$, and for the data sets D1 to D3.

Wide pair, $w_{11}<0$, ordered limit ($\epsilon\to0$ at fixed $u$, then $u\to0$): small-$u$ expansions of $\mathcal E_4$ through $u^3$, of $\nu\mathcal C$ and of the relative correction $\varsigma\sqrt{1+u^2}\,\mathcal C/(4a)$ of $\mathfrak m_b$ through $u^4$, and of $\beta_i\Xi_i=\beta_i(X_3u^3+X_4u^4+X_5u^5)+O(u^6)$, with explicit coefficients.

open_issues: The remainders are not shown to be uniform in u (the gap s−j vanishes as u→0); (14.12)–(14.13) are derived only as the ordered limit.
The data on which (1+u²)C = 4E₄, where (11.16) survives at relative order ε², are not characterized.
On odd r (sector Θ = −1) the w12, w21 terms of (14.4) may produce a further level near the band; other levels are out of scope.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions and degree-one homogeneity under scaling of M_i, τ_i and the w's
Ordered limit u→0 for w11<0 at j(P)>0 (not at the flat-band point a1=a2, P≡π/2 mod π): E_b(P) tends to the band minimum of ω1+ω2 through order ε⁴, and all order-ε⁴ coefficients at P=0 vanish
Numerical diagonalization of H(P) for three data sets and three values of ε: deviations scale as ε⁴ from (11.14) and as ε⁶ from (14.6)-(14.9); effective operator (14.4) on a ring to ε⁶
